title: Sindhu Claims Japan Open Title with Dominant Win Over Akane Yamaguchi
indian_angle: PV Sindhu, India's star shuttler, secured a significant Super 750 title, marking a strong comeback and answering her critics.
summary: PV Sindhu ended her title drought by winning the Japan Open, defeating home favourite Akane Yamaguchi in a scorching final performance.

title: Sindhu, Shetty Exit China Open Super 1000 After Wasting Match Points
indian_angle: India's top female shuttler PV Sindhu and rising male talent Ayush Shetty both failed to advance in the prestigious China Open, despite holding match points.
summary: PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty both suffered disappointing exits from the China Open Super 1000, unable to convert match points in their respective matches.

title: Ayush Shetty Triumphs Over Alwi Farhan in China Open Battle of Future Stars
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty showcased his potential by defeating Malaysia's Alwi Farhan, a fellow rising star, at the China Open.
summary: Indian prodigy Ayush Shetty secured a notable victory against Malaysia's Alwi Farhan at the China Open, highlighting a promising future for the young player.

title: Player Eligibility Announced for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: Badminton Association of India has released the eligibility criteria for Indian players aspiring to represent the country at the BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The BAI has issued a circular detailing the eligibility requirements for Indian players seeking selection for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: A significant change to the scoring system, adopting 3x15, has been implemented for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the adoption of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic junior ranking tournaments and national championships, aiming to debut the format soon.

title: Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Tournament Held in Chennai
indian_angle: India's top senior shuttlers competed in the Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament held in Chennai, a crucial event for national rankings.
summary: The Badminton Association of India issued a circular for the Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026, which took place in Chennai from July 16th to 23rd.
